description: THAM DO TRUOC `case_sustained_stacked.json`. Chay cai nay (7 phut) truoc cai kia (40 phut). No tra loi dung MOT cau hoi chan: giet `quote` thi `shipping` co sinh span STATUS_CODE_ERROR that khong, hay `shipping` nuot loi bang fallback im lang. Neu nuot thi su kien 2 cua kich ban dai se FAIL vi ly do SAI, va ta se mat 40 phut + lam gian doan cum ma khong hoc duoc gi.
notes: DOC KET QUA THE NAO. PASS = `shipping` co alert `service-error-rate-high` trong cua so -> cap quote/shipping dung duoc, chay tiep kich ban dai. FAIL = khong co alert nao -> `shipping` khong bao loi khi `quote` chet (nhieu kha nang co fallback, hoac loi nam o span CLIENT ma rule khong dem). Khi do PHAI doi cap khac chu KHONG duoc chay kich ban dai.

NEU FAIL THI DOI SANG DAU. Rang buoc van nguyen: nan nhan cua su kien 2 khong duoc la `frontend`, `checkout` hay `cart` (ca ba deu do san vi su kien 1 giet cart). Ung vien tiep theo, theo do thi do 30/07: `productCatalogFailure`-style — giet `product-catalog` thi `recommendation` va `product-reviews` cung do, va ca hai deu KHONG goi cart. Nhung ban kinh rong hon han (product-catalog con bi frontend + checkout goi), nen chi dung khi quote/shipping that su khong duoc.

VI SAO 360s CHU KHONG PHAI 180s (doi 30/07). Query cua rule dung `rate(...[5m])`. Bom 180s thi cua so 5m chi chua 180s loi tren 300s — ti le doc duoc chi bang ~60% muc thuc, va service se bi xep NHAM DAI khi doi chieu voi nguong. Phai bom >= 300s cho cua so bao hoa, cong them margin de co vai mau sach. Van la ngan so voi 40 phut cua kich ban dai.

CHAY KEM `aiops/blast_radius_probe.py` DE TRA LOI MOT CAU HOI SAU HON. Ban than kich ban nay chi cham diem tren `shipping`. Nhung con mot cau quan trong hon ma format kich ban khong hoi duoc: giet mot service thi TUNG service khac roi vao ti le loi bao nhieu, va co cai nao roi vao DAI [0.05, 0.10) khong.

  python aiops/blast_radius_probe.py --prom-url http://localhost:9090 --target quote

Vi sao dai do quan trong: `service-error-rate-high` co tang TINH nguong 0.10 va tang dong bi cong SLO chan duoi 0.05. Ngoai dai do thi hoac tang tinh ganh (baseline vo can), hoac khong keu. Tuc FREEZE — thu MANDATE-28 noi ve — chi co y nghia trong dai do. Bom bang `--replicas=0` cho ti le ~1.0, nen kich ban dai se PASS yeu cau 1 nho tang tinh chu KHONG chung minh duoc freeze.

PROBE CON KIEM MOT THU NUA: service nao co baseline loi. Do 30/07 tren cum: chi 5/15 service co traffic la CO chuoi tu so; 10 service con lai (ad, cart, currency, image-provider, payment, product-reviews, quote, recommendation, shipping, shopping-copilot) chua tung phat ra span loi nao nen KHONG co `metric_history`. Voi chung, mot su co duoi nguong SLO se khong bao gio duoc phat hien — baseline bat dau tu chinh gia tri su co nen tang dong khong the keu, tang tinh thi chua toi nguong, va freeze vo nghia vi khong co baseline lanh de dong bang. Nguyen nhan la `service-error-rate-high` thieu mac dinh 0 o tu so, dung loi da sua cho 4 rule burn-rate o PR #509.

LENH CUU HO neu tien trinh chet giua chung:
    kubectl scale deploy/quote -n techx-tf1 --replicas=2
TIEN QUYET giong kich ban dai: `memory-saturation-high` phai duoi 0.85 (30/07 prometheus-server o 0.887 va da OOMKilled that), va cum khong dang co load test chay.
